title: LDAP
description: Adds an LDAP directory for looking up contacts.

LDAPAccountPassword.title: Account password
LDAPAccountPassword.description: The user's password. Only use this in encrypted profiles.

LDAPAccountUseSSL.title: Use SSL
LDAPAccountUseSSL.description: If true, the system enables SSL.

LDAPSearchSettings.title: Search settings
LDAPSearchSettings.description: An array of search settings dictionaries.

LDAPSearchSettingDescription.title: Description
LDAPSearchSettingDescription.description: The description of this search setting.

LDAPSearchSettingScope.title: Search setting scope
LDAPSearchSettingScope.description:
The type of recursion to use in the search:

- LDAPSearchSettingScopeBase: The search uses only the immediate node that the search base points to.
- LDAPSearchSettingScopeOneLevel: The search uses the node plus its immediate children.
- LDAPSearchSettingScopeSubtree: The search uses the node plus all children, regardless of depth.

enum_titles: LDAP search setting scope one level

LDAPSearchSettingSearchBase.title: Search setting search base
LDAPSearchSettingSearchBase.description: The path to the node where a search should start.

VPNUUID.title: VPNUUID
VPNUUID.description: The VPNUUID of the per-app VPN the account uses for network communication.
